name: Borsfa (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of green and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Borsfa (a green and white shield with a red charge, supported by two yellow lions) above a yellow scroll inscribed BORSFA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Borsfa arms with lion supporters and scroll
